title: Story Ecology and Answerable Power
purpose: Compile separate actor stories, exact overlap stories, constitutional mechanism stories, and tested counterpower answers without collapsing adjacency into integration or formal safeguards into effective power.
governing_question: Can affected people or accountable institutions inspect, pause, challenge, reverse, replace, govern, and recover value from systems that can otherwise act on them?

story_modes.question: What is the actor's own history, institutional bargain, rights, operating role, public claims, limits, failures, and counterpower?
Which dated instruments, people, programs, transactions, interfaces, standards, or deployments actually connect two or more standalone stories?
How are purpose, categories, thresholds, evidence, action rights, exceptions, burdens, benefit, and remedy allocated?
What intervention changed the distribution of power in practice, for whom, at what stage, and with what durable outcome?
Which tempting overlap, causal bridge, identity join, or common-purpose claim does not survive exact review?

power_answer_ladder.name: representation
power_answer_ladder.test: The person or public is visible to the system but has no demonstrated authority over it.

power_answer_ladder.name: notice_and_voice
power_answer_ladder.test: The affected party receives timely notice and can speak before irreversible consequence.

power_answer_ladder.name: inspection_and_correction
power_answer_ladder.test: The affected party or representative can inspect material evidence and correct records or classifications.

power_answer_ladder.name: pause_and_burden_shift
power_answer_ladder.test: An independent actor can stay action and require the acting institution to justify the threshold, category, or necessity.

power_answer_ladder.name: reversal_and_remedy
power_answer_ladder.test: A decision or consequence can be reversed with restoration, compensation, deletion, or other effective remedy.

power_answer_ladder.name: substitution_and_public_capacity
power_answer_ladder.test: The system or vendor can be replaced while preserving data, workflow, continuity, accountability, and service quality.

power_answer_ladder.name: co_governance
power_answer_ladder.test: Affected people possess enforceable authority over purposes, categories, thresholds, oversight, and termination.

power_answer_ladder.name: value_recovery
power_answer_ladder.test: Public or affected parties recover a proportionate share of value, learning, IP, or institutional benefit created through public authority, data, risk, labor, or injury.
